the role of communication breakdowns in the process of building shared meaning, and how this is affected by the organizational context of the participants.
the role of shared meaning in virtual team performance, and how to create translucence in the organizational context.
the complexity of virtual team collaboration and the need to create translucence in the virtual team environment.

the more complex the communication structure of a virtual team is, the higher the likelihood of communication breakdowns and the more important it becomes to build shared meaning.

virtual team collaboration is a complex task, and that the complexity is increased by geographically distributed participants.

virtual team collaboration is about building shared meaning, which is achieved by resolving communication breakdowns and creating transcultural translucence.
building shared meanings is an ongoing process that requires continuous reflection at different levels of the organization.

building shared meaning is a process that requires critical reflection at all three levels and that the process of building shared meaning can be supported by creating translucence between participants.
